messages:
clara: Quick thread to finalize autofallback alerting UX. Problem: immediate pagers for fallbacks create noise on bursty public routes. Proposal: digest-first + tiered pager rules + compact audit schema.
diego: Totally agree. Two core constraints: keep an immutable decision_trace for compliance and make alerting configurable per-rollout.
rahul: Implementation note: routing will emit a single flat event per fallback decision to the stream. Sanitizer will redact excerpts and emit the final audit record. UI reads the redacted record.
ui-zoe: UX wants the console to show a tiny "fallback state" pill on rollout rows (green/amber/red). Clicking opens an audit card: tiny timeline (request -> why -> action -> returned excerpt). Excerpt must be redacted or show a reason why it's hidden.
clara: Schema needs to be agreed. Keep it flat and minimal so stream consumers don't break. Suggested fields: evt_id, ts, route, rollout_id, decision_code, decision_human, degrade_type, original_model, fallback_model, latency_ms, prompt_sig, excerpt_redacted, redaction_level, telemetry_tags_csv, alert_eligible_true_false, retention_days.
rahul: Agree. telemetry_tags_csv must include experiment flags so we can toggle behavior. Also add a small field decision_trace_sig (sha256 of the trace) referencing the immutable decision_trace stream for deep forensic.
ops-bot: policy: any non-redacted excerpt requires compliance approval. Schema changes require staged rollout + migration plan.
diego: Paging/playbook suggestion: page only when (unique_routes_impacted_5m >= 4 AND fallback_events_total_1m >= 12) OR when any hard-degrade occurs on a route with p99 latency > 3x baseline. Otherwise send digest to #oncall and pin console.
ui-zoe: Console affordance: per-rollout "digest mode" toggle (default off). When enabled events set alert_eligible_false in telemetry tags. Tooltip: "Delay paging and group similar fallbacks into a digest to reduce noise."
clara: Also want a visible note in the audit card when digest suppressed a page: "suppressed: grouped with 4 other fallbacks in 3m" so oncall knows why there's no pager.
rahul: Metrics to emit: fallback_events_total_1m, fallback_unique_routes_5m, grouped_fallback_clusters_1h, suppressed_page_count_24h. Dashboards will help tune thresholds during the experiment.
ops-bot: reminder: update playbook & run a 2-week staged rollout.
oncall: I'll validate thresholds with SLO owners and add a one-click emergency opt-out on the console for critical routes.
diego: I'll open a PR with the flat schema examples and migration notes. rahul -> sanitizer spec. ui-zoe -> console mockups and copy. oncall -> playbook thresholds. Clara will coordinate compliance sign-off. Back here next Monday for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
